title: AMD and Intel Arc cards get the NVIDIA engine on current Windows 11 (wmic is gone)
description: GPU detection for AMD/Intel Arc runs wmic, which recent Windows 11 builds no longer ship. The probe errors, reports no AMD/Intel card, and the installer falls back to the NVIDIA portable build. Reported by a Discord user with an RX 6800. Fix: query Win32_VideoController through PowerShell Get-CimInstance instead.
